VBO:0200827.summary: Valued by local hunters for its scent-hunting ability, the Liangshan Dog is a regional mountain hound of western Sichuan in China. Endurance is among its described working strengths in rugged terrain, where it belongs to a local hunting tradition.
VBO:0200827.shortDescription: A western Sichuan scent hunter, valued locally for mountain hunting and described as an enduring working hound.

sources.title: Beregovoy and Chen Chiaoxian: Liangshan dogs, Journal of PADS No.28 (2011)

Exact Liangshan is a medium scenthound valued by hunters for hunting ability, with rounded lop ears and bushy tail curving over back. Whole own adult photos personally viewed; puppy explicitly excluded. Speculated Sabaneev mahugou ancestry and Laika resemblance not biological transfer.
